description: Violations of architecture/modules.json that cannot be fixed yet. Each entry names the rule, the importing files, how many occurrences are allowed, and the migration step that removes them. pnpm arch:check fails on any violation beyond these and on any entry that allows more than remains, so the list only shrinks.

exceptions.reason: The resource stores write files through the platform helper; they move behind the same StateStore port as the Controller state.
The update commands read Controller releases through the helper in relay-core; M10 moves release lookup to a module both sides import.

App.tsx is 3,649 lines of hook wiring and render. M13 moved the rules out into src/state (nine modules, each with a written contract and a unit table); the state hooks and JSX still sit in AppContent. Open item O16 splits them.
Controller tests wire the Relay, providers and the Workbench by file path. The wiring moves into the seam suites of agent-remote-seams and provider ./testing entries as M10 extracts session-core.
Claude tests reach the Controller and the built catalog worker by path; they move to the S1 seam suite and a recordings entry in M10.
Codex tests run the provider through the session runtime and the Controller by path; they move to the S1 seam suite in M10.
Debugger tests start the Workbench server and the built CLI by path; they move to the agent-e2e stack in M12.
